content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text treats C4 as moot because the challenged curse limb was dropped, rather than weighing a pressed chain against a live link verse by verse.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"When the witnesses pressed against a link — I weighed (A) the rule governs only a live link still in the chain versus (B) it governs even a dropped link once witnesses were pressed against it.","why":"The judge disposes of C4 as moot because the challenged curse limb was dropped, not by applying a verse-by-verse stating-verse test to a live pressed chain, so K-C does not require a chain-vs-chain weighing here."}
